summary: Chart ticks, legend names and tooltip series names are set in the new footnote role instead of label-sm with a font-regular override (#59). The size and weight are unchanged (12px, 400). The leading moves from label-sm's 1.3 to footnote's 1.35, so a line is 16.2px instead of 15.6px. A legend entry keeps its 4px block padding around the taller line, so it measures 24.2px instead of 24; it still clears the 24px target.
